title: NORTHWIND TEA
style: warm documentary photography, a white kitchen counter by a large window, morning sunlight falling across the worktop, bright and airy, natural textures, shallow depth of field, high detail

music.tags: warm nostalgic strings, soft piano, gentle, hazy, wistful, instrumental

beats.prompt: Loose black tea leaves spilling from a plain paper packet onto a wooden counter, warm morning light, close-up
beats.motion: The leaves settle. Light drifts across them.
beats.caption: Some mornings start slowly

line.text: Some mornings you need the day to start slowly.

beats.prompt: Hot water poured over tea leaves in a glass pot, steam rising, backlit, close-up, the water darkening
beats.motion: The water pours and darkens. Steam rises and curls.
beats.caption: A plain black tea

line.text: Northwind is a plain black tea. No claims, no ceremony.

beats.sfx: water pouring into a glass pot

beats.prompt: A ceramic mug of tea on a windowsill with rain on the glass behind it, soft grey light, cosy mood
beats.motion: Rain runs down the glass. Steam drifts from the mug.
beats.caption: Dried slowly. Packed the same week.

line.text: Grown on a hillside, dried slowly, packed the same week.

beats.prompt: Two hands wrapped around a warm mug, close-up, soft window light, quiet and human
beats.motion: The hands hold still. Steam drifts.
beats.caption: NORTHWIND - take the long way

line.text: Northwind. Take the long way through the morning.
